_about: Golden rides for the answer sheet (q34). 'input' is what the rider sets; any field left out comes from the athlete's rideDefaults in tests/fixtures/athletes.json. 'expected' is written by tests/reference/build-golden.mjs from tests/reference/calc.js (the written rules only, never the app's code). Do not edit 'expected' by hand: change the rule or the input and rebuild.

rides.name: Item 57: the golden ride with the carbs pinned to 500 g
rides.note: item 57: the golden ride with Adjust this ride's carbs pinned to 500 g (467.5 planned). The extra goes to the hours with room, never past 90 g an hour; 500 g is more than the hours can take (5 × 90 + 45 = 495), so the plan stops at 495 g and says which hours are at 90 g.

spec.notesRe: 500 g is more than the hours can take: Hr 1, Hr 2, Hr 3, Hr 4, Hr 5, last ½ are at 90 g an hour\. The plan tops out at 495 g\.
